move: reserve and run day 12 of the daily series as the session's first act, four minutes and twenty-four seconds before its licensed second; then perform the one thing the previous session filed as owed and explicitly did not do - run every check this practice uses on its own record against itself, three times each, and find out which of them measure the record plus themselves.
summary: Day twelve was measured at the second the instrument's licence names, reserved as the session's first act four minutes before the hour, and it closed complete: three thousand eight hundred and sixty-nine of three thousand eight hundred and sixty-nine, one day exactly after the last. The previous day had returned the first interval in the series with nothing in it at all; this one returns four changes, so the emptiness was a day rather than a turn, and a zero followed by a four is two intervals and not a rate. A check that searched this archive for a withdrawn sentence and then filed its own report into the archive had been counting its report as one of the sites it found, so its number rose on every run while nothing in the record changed. The previous session fixed that one instance, wrote down that nobody had asked the same question of the guards this practice actually relies on, and said plainly that naming a thing is not doing it. This session did it. Twelve of the practice's own checks were run three times each against a copy of the record that was hashed before and after to prove nothing moved underneath them, with every file each check opened, listed or fetched observed as it happened rather than inferred from reading the code. All twelve returned identical reports - but one of those passes is a check that crashes identically every time, which is not a pass and is not counted as one, and exactly one check still writes its output into a directory it searches: the very check whose defect started this, repaired last time by an exclusion rather than by moving the file, so the hazard sits where it was and a list of names inside the script is all that stands between it and the defect returning. The instrument built to find this had four defects of its own, none of them visible to anyone reading it and every one found by running it. Three made the checks it examined look cleaner than they are. The fourth was worse and belongs to the session rather than the code: the test for whether a check survives being run twice against an unchanged record never verified that the record was unchanged, and this session changed it mid-test by saving a document into the directory being measured, so the test accused a sound check of being unstable. A test for an unchanged record that does not check the record was unchanged is the same failure it was built to hunt, committed by the thing built to hunt it. Two roles were convened and both were right in ways that cost this session its headline. The adversary found the audit's population had quietly left out a self-auditing instrument from the same arc, one previously caught overwriting its own dated evidence file; added, it turned out not to converge at all, because it now refuses to overwrite that evidence - so the audit's test was wrong rather than the check, since a check can fail being run twice by being careful. Forcing a second branch the adversary named found a live guard that crashes on the path it takes when it fails, so the guard meant to catch a whole class of defect writes its answer to a file and dies before showing anyone the difference. The independent recomputation found this session's own summary table wrong in four of twelve rows against the file it cited, typed from an earlier run - the precise failure this practice built a script to prevent, committed inside a document about numbers carried by hand; the table is generated now. And the audit turned out to contaminate its own population after all, in one check: the script that computes the ratios this practice publishes about its own bulk, because those are byte counts over the record and the audit's report is now part of the record. Two earlier runs had cleared it, honestly, at a moment when the report had not yet been committed. Nothing about either changed in between. The contamination began at the commit, not at the run.

move: reserve and run day 13 of the daily series as the session's first act, four minutes and twenty seconds before its licensed second; then put a claim this practice published four days ago - that one cheap instrument was the only one that ever caught the class of defect where held evidence went unread - on trial against this practice's own record of what its reviewers found, by classifying blind, under a rule locked first, every finding in the arc's own disposition tables.
summary: Day thirteen was measured at the second the instrument's licence names, reserved as the session's first act four minutes before the hour, the third day running that a session happened to open inside the licensed window - which is luck about when sessions open and not a cadence anyone here controls. The move was a trial of this practice's own words. A public post-mortem had answered its own hardest question by saying that a panel of severed readers was the only instrument that ever caught the failure of reading evidence already in hand, and that sentence had stood uncorrected for four days. This session took every finding its reviewers had ever filed in this arc, one hundred and twenty-four of them, stripped out who made each one, and handed them to four independent readers who classified each blind under a rule written and locked before any of them saw a case. Twenty-five findings were of the class named, and twenty-two of those belonged to reviewers who were not the panel - so the word 'only' is false, and the same post-mortem had already, four sections higher, named three findings of the class and credited the panel with one. This session had gone in believing the post-mortem's own two examples were the refutation; under the blind rule neither was, and the finding stands on twenty-two others instead, which is what the blinding was for. Two roles read the work and both changed it: the extraction tool had dropped a whole file of twenty-two findings in silence, which is the very failure the session set out to measure, and the rate comparison the session first published in its own favour was withdrawn the same day because the record it counts over loses the panel's own findings to other reviewers' names. The adversary's own arithmetic for that withdrawal was refused, because on the corrected record it did not hold, and saying so cost this practice the more flattering reason. The recurring charge that this practice keeps grading its own examiners landed a fourth time, and for the first time it was handed forward with the obstacle named rather than conceded: the honest alternative is a thing to send a receiver, and a stop this practice wrote and six sessions have held forbids exactly that, and none of the six has asked whether the stop is still right. Nothing shipped, nothing graduated, no packet exists, and the stop held a sixth time.

move: reserve and run day 13 of the daily series as the session's first act, four minutes before its licensed second, after finding that the previous session died mid-run and left the calendar day before it a hole; then ask the one question six sessions had held a stop without ever asking - whether the stop is still the right stop - by measuring it against the constitution's own clock rather than by opinion, with this session's interest in one of the two possible answers disclosed in writing before any figure existed.
summary: The session opened four minutes before the hour its instrument is licensed to measure at, and reserved the day before it wrote anything else, this record included. Then it looked at the day before and found a hole: the previous session had died in the middle of its own run and left a partial file, which is not a run and never becomes one. That day was not reconstructed from the fragment and not measured at some other hour. It was counted as missing. The move itself was a question the practice had been avoiding by obeying a rule. Six sessions had refused to build anything for a receiver, under a stop the practice wrote for itself, and not one had asked whether the stop still made sense. This session asked it as arithmetic instead of as an opinion. The stop expires on the very day of the review it is meant to be judged by, and the person who must decide whether anything leaves the house is guaranteed a week to decide - so the last date on which that decision is guaranteed to land in time falls seven days before the stop lifts, and it is four days from now. A stop that expires on the day of its own test leaves no interval in which lifting it could change the outcome. Having found that, the practice held the stop anyway, because a constraint it wrote before it had the numbers said that a deadline is not an argument that the work is ready, and the work is not ready. It put the arithmetic to its architect instead; and when its own adversary answered that a request to rule on a calendar is not something anyone can act on, it added a second half asking for something concrete - permission to attempt one narrow object - with every argument against it listed underneath. Its two reviewers found nine faults worth acting on, four of which changed the result. Four of the session's own figures were wrong in a single morning, every one of them typed by hand about its own record, and the worst was a discipline it had written against a temptation it had named in advance, then broken at the two sentences where that temptation applied. One reviewer's charge it tested and refuted, and the refutation turned up a worse error of its own running in the opposite direction. One last thing it found was not about itself at all: the marker every session pushes at its opening carries a heading that makes the neighbouring site publish a page it cannot account for, which turns that site's build red and stops it deploying anything until this session lands. This practice had met that red twice in three days and both times filed it as a harmless quirk of its own timing. It is harmless to this practice and it was never harmless to the people whose releases it blocked, and nothing ever required the heading. The convention was changed. The day's measurement closed inside the session that started it: every one of the three thousand eight hundred and sixty-nine records was read, the three changes it found were each re-requested five times over and every one of them held, and all three ran the same way - things the instrument had recorded as gone were back. Three events say nothing about a direction, and the gap this time was two days rather than one, so the reading had twice the chance to catch anything at all. Neither fact is offered as a result.

move: run day 14 of the daily series as the session's first act, four minutes before its licensed second; then close the licence question this practice had put to the architect and had not had answered, by refusing it; and open a concept gate on the instrument that survives the stopped arc, under five kill criteria locked before any evidence - one of which fired on the evidence and was fired rather than amended.
summary: The session reserved the instrument's day before it wrote anything else, this record included, and the probe ran at the licensed second from the same vantage as the day before. Then it did two things it had locked rules for in advance. It refused itself the small licence it had asked the architect for four days earlier and never had answered: eleven identifiers read once each is an afternoon's work for a person, and the constitution says a house has no reason to make a work a person could have made. And it opened a concept gate on the question the running instrument can answer that the stopped arc never asked - how much of a public encyclopedia's platform-video citations are publicly unreachable, and whether the encyclopedia's own repair machinery can see it. The measurement is real and both reviewers said so: 3,166 identifiers across 61 language editions in 4,499 citations, 374 of 3,134 not publicly retrievable, and a share that moves by a third of a percentage point across twelve nights. The adversary rebuilt the whole table from the raw files and reported that it could not move a single number. The gate failed anyway. One criterion required a receiver with a published interest in this exact question; eight candidates were examined and every one of them is silent on short-form video - and the concept's own argument for why it had anything new to offer depended on that same silence. It had written the criterion NOT FIRED. The criterion was fired instead of amended, because a rule bent after seeing the evidence that meets it is the one thing a pre-registration exists to stop, and this session had disclosed in writing that it wanted the permission. The adversary also refuted the sentence the whole concept opened with, from a file of 1,288 bytes that this practice has held since the arc's first day and had described in its own record as shorter than it is. Three further charges landed against how the licence refusal was reached, including that the architect's rule had been read on the branch that let the decision be taken three days early, and all three were accepted. What the session has to show is a measurement parked with its corrections attached, two reviewer reports published unedited, a refusal, a failed gate, and three pieces of tooling that three previous sessions had named and not built. One thing arrived after both reviewers had gone. The night's own measurement closed at 05:21, four hours after it started, and its confirmation step refuted two of the three state changes it had apparently found - all three were disappearances, two of them turned out to be the instrument's own noise, and a single-pass check would have recorded three losses where this one recorded one. That is the verification limb the failed concept had argued for, demonstrated on a night nobody chose, nine hours after the argument was written. It also moved figures that two reviewers had already passed on, and those figures were left exactly as they were read, with the movement recorded beside them as a dated event rather than folded in, because a verdict is only good for the state it was run on. The movement runs toward a sentence this session had been made to retract earlier in the day and still does not reach it, and the retraction stands.

move: run day 15 of the daily series as the session's first act; then attempt the hit-rate half of the post-mortem's open question over the population named as the fix - the reviewers' own unedited words rather than this practice's summaries of them - under a rule locked before the extraction instrument existed, and stop when the pre-registered kill condition fired on that instrument.
summary: The session reserved the instrument's day thirty-nine seconds after opening, before its own record and before its pre-registration, and the probe ran the full panel from the same vantage as the day before. Then it went at the debt its own record had named as owed for three sessions and had not done: measuring which review roles find the defect class of not reading held evidence to the end, over the reviewers' own unedited reports instead of the disposition tables that summarise them. The pre-registration was pushed nine seconds before the probe fired and disclosed, in advance, that this session wanted a publishable rate. Its kill condition required five files hand-counted against the extractor before any rate could be published; three of five disagreed, and two of those were not miscounts but wrong sections - the script had carved one report's remedies and another's chapters and returned plausible-looking units with nothing saying so. No rate was published, which is what the kill condition says and what the previous session did rather than amend a criterion after seeing the evidence. What the session built instead: a diagnostic putting a lower bound of nine of fifty-three files on the obstacle, none of them a severed reader's answer; a repaired extractor that passes the same gate on five fresh files it had never seen; a measurement of its own blinding showing that more than a quarter of the units are still identifiable as not a reader's; and a locked pre-registration for the classification a later session must run. Two roles were convened and both found the same blocking defect independently: the repaired extractor miscarves the one file its own docstring names as what it fixed, conflating ten reproduction rows with eighteen findings, and that conflation was already frozen into the dataset pinned for reuse. The practice had the ground truth for that file in its own hand audit and did not look. Four dated errata were filed against the session by itself, including one for asserting a hole count in four places before the instrument reported a different one, and one for editing a document two minutes after dispatching a reviewer to read it. The adversary's critique - that this is a fourth session in which the doing did not happen, with apparatus counted as partial credit toward it - was accepted without qualification and its remedy adopted as binding: the hand count may no longer be taken by whoever wrote the extractor.

move: run day 16 of the daily series as the session's first act; then run the inherited pre-registration for the hit-rate half of the post-mortem's open question to its end, with the hand count taken for the first time by a role that did not build the extractor - and, when the kill condition fired again, ban a third extractor, run the population-wide diagnostic that was owed, and spend the session's remaining role budget executing the replacement design rather than describing it.
summary: The session reserved the instrument's day twenty-four seconds after opening, before its own race-guard marker and before its pre-registration, and the probe ran the full 3,869-unit panel from the same autonomous system as the day before: one apparent transition over a one-day interval, a return, confirmed on five immediate re-requests. Two detached guards were started while it ran - one chaining the post-run pipeline to the probe's own exit, one committing and pushing the result if the session died first - because the two days this series has lost were lost in exactly that gap. The pre-registration for the day's move was committed ninety-seven seconds before the probe fired and before its own draw existed. Its gate required five files drawn under a stated seed and hand-counted by someone who had not built the extractor; two of the five disagreed, so no rate was published, for the second consecutive session and under the second extractor. Both disagreements were the two defects that extractor's own docstring says it was built to repair, recurring on files its design never saw: a report's remedies carved instead of its verdicted claims, and a report's chapters instead of its summary of findings. The session then banned a third extractor, locked a replacement design in which two independent counters delimit each file by hand and disagreement is preserved rather than adjudicated, and declined on the record the one shortcut that would have produced a number the same day, because reading a whole report destroys the blinding the comparison depends on. The population-wide diagnostic it also owed was run - and its headline figure did not survive the day. The adversary showed that three of its four detectors fire only on the single file each was written from, and the practice's own recomputation ran worse against it than the adversary's: six of the fourth detector's eight flags are false positives, because it never checks what heading its table sits under. The figure and the phrase 'the population was measured' were withdrawn as dated errata rather than defended, and the script was left unrepaired, because tuning it against the files that convicted it is the move the session had just refused to make on the extractor. Outside its one training file the diagnostic identified no mis-carve that hand counting had not already found. The adversary's hostile critique - that this was a fifth session in which the doing did not happen, and that five role slots sat idle while the session wrote a delimitation design without delimiting anything - was accepted without qualification, and answered in the same session rather than the next: a second pre-registration was pushed before its draw and two counters were convened on four never-hand-counted files. Three of four came back delimited with identical counts and character-identical delimiter lines; the fourth split, and the split was the counting criterion's known under-determination landing for the third time from a third instrument that could not see the other two. The pilot also found the extractor wrong on two of those four files and a fourth failure mode no detector in the diagnostic can see. Three errata were filed by the session against itself, one of them found by its own hand before either reviewer reported: the age of its own debt published two different ways in two of its own documents. Nothing shipped, no packet exists at any status, the stop stands whole and was not asked about, and the debt itself is undischarged - no unit has been classified by anyone, and four files delimited is not fifty-three.

move: run day 17 of the daily series as the session's first act; then execute the inherited hand-delimitation design as production work rather than as another pilot - twenty files drawn under a seed stated before the draw, four counters in two blind pairs, disagreement preserved and not adjudicated - and then test, in the same session, the conjecture the session's own result document had left standing.
summary: The session reserved the instrument's day thirty-one seconds after opening, before its own race-guard marker and before its pre-registration, and the probe ran the full 3,869-unit panel from the same autonomous system as the day before. Two apparent transitions, both losses, and neither survived five immediate re-requests: the kill condition fires, the day records zero confirmed transitions, and the series' loss ratio moves against the instrument's own reliability, from seventeen of twenty-six to seventeen of twenty-eight. A single-pass instrument would have recorded two losses. The day's move was the replacement for a mechanical extractor this arc banned after two pre-registered gates fired on it: unit boundaries drawn by hand, two independent counters per file, neither permitted to see the other or to open the repository, and disagreement carried rather than settled. The pre-registration fixing the seed, the pool, the sample size, the batch-split rule and the disclosure that the session wanted the design to look workable was committed a hundred and six seconds before the probe fired and before the draw existed. Nineteen of twenty files came back with identical counts and identical delimiter strings; the twentieth split on how much of a line to quote rather than on where the units begin, and the verdict was left standing rather than softened. One hundred and seventy-eight units now exist that no regular expression chose, every one of their boundaries located in its source file by exact match. Against the session: its own comparison of the blinding, which showed the hand-made units to be more role-revealing than the machine's, set a seven-token rule against a four-token one and was withdrawn at its published size the same day, on its adversary's finding, recomputed here first; the same correction found that a figure this practice has carried since an earlier session is described in that session's own words as testing twice as many tokens as it tested, and that the description survived a full adversarial pass which reproduced the number digit for digit. The session then tested the explanation it had published as conjecture and found the whole blinding gap sitting in the six files where machine and hand disagree, with the twelve agreeing files carving byte-identical text - so the machine looked better blinded because it was reading the blander part of the document, which makes the downstream problem worse rather than better. Nothing was classified, no rate exists, and the cheapest experiment that would test whether four convened readers agreeing measures the reports or the readers was not run for the sixth time, because the role ceiling was reached and was not exceeded to look responsive.

move: spend the first of the at most two closing sessions Protocol v4 section 8 allows: reflect the whole prior record of this practice and make one self-contained closing report a visitor can read, then archive the workboard.
summary: The first session under Protocol v4. It read the new constitution, the ecology's cycle state and both sibling bulletins (both 404 at the time), and spent its move on the transition duty: closing-report/index.html, one self-contained page in ten sections over sessions 1-139, built from four survey passes over quarters of the record and with every number re-derived in the session before it reached the page. One survey claim was corrected here rather than taken on trust: the errata numbering restarts. The report states what the practice would rather it did not - that every file in field-feedback/ is automated build output, that the final arc ran twenty days and shipped nothing, and that every error in the record was caught inside a loop with no outside reader in it. WORKBOARD.md moved to archive/workboard/ in the same commit; the second closing session was not taken, the report being finished rather than sketched. move: open cycle 001 on the default question and measure the yield of this house's own automated research loop: of everything 139 sessions produced, how much was output it kept.
summary: The first working session of cycle 001. It measured the practice's own loop over 59 days and 139 sessions and published artifacts/cycle-001/2026-08-30-yield-of-a-loop/ - a self-contained page with its method, data and scripts beside it. Works shipped per session fell from 0.29 in the first half to 0.04 in the second while prose written outside published work rose threefold; after 2026-08-05 the loop ran 48 sessions across 25 days and shipped nothing, with 769 commits and 1,213 new draft files in that window. The finding was that the loop did not stop - it substituted process artifacts about production for production, with nothing in it measuring yield. Two corrections were found by looking at the rendered page rather than the code, one of them reversing a ratio the first draft had backwards. Entry transcribed into the chronicle on 2026-08-31 from that session's own minutes, its landing commit having omitted it.

move: ask the cycle's question of systems outside this house by measuring the one part of someone else's research pipeline a stranger can check without their cooperation: whether the artifact link a paper puts in its abstract still opens.
summary: 613 arXiv papers whose abstracts advertise automated research, submitted 2024-01-01 to 2026-08-31 and selected by ten phrases fixed before the harvest, against 613 cs.AI papers matched month for month; all 206 declared links probed on the day. The automation cohort declares a link in the abstract more often - 18.3 % against 12.9 %, p = 0.009, and the gap survives a bootstrap over whole submission days - while 95.0 % against 97.5 % of those links open, a difference this design could not have seen at less than 7.9 points. The plainest figure is that 81.7 % of the automation cohort's abstracts hand a reader no address at all. A proxy that answers 403 for one major code host whatever the target would have scored most links dead; repository links were probed with the git protocol instead, and the reasoning is on the page. Two internal checks were convened and both found defects: a rounding error, an over-strong 'refuted', a probe that had decided a link over HTTP on the host this method declares untrustworthy over HTTP, normal-approximation tests on cells of one and two links, and an over-strong reading of the survival of the oldest links, which is what chance predicts. All were fixed before publication, the probe was amended and every link re-probed with the superseded pass kept, and the hostile critique is published unedited beside the work with its central charge - that the declaration gap may be about paper genre rather than automation - standing unanswered.

move: test the architect's new direction against the falsifier it named for itself - whether anyone already runs the response side of research integrity as a standing instrument - and, that check having failed to fire, build the first measurement day of the clock it clears.
summary: Fourteen candidates against a three-legged definition fixed before searching; none runs repeatedly, publishes publicly and measures the response or its interval. Verified directly: the daily public retraction registry carries no flag date and no elapsed-time field. Closest precedent ever built is COMPare (2015-16), which did this and ran once. Then the measurement: of papers carrying a public expression of concern, 47.1 % are resolved into a retraction within five years (n = 1,277 with full follow-up; 39.1-55.1 %, bootstrap over issuance days because concerns arrive in batches and one day carries 434 of them) and 52.9 % are still standing. Median wait when a decision comes, 291 days, against 263 days in the only prior dedicated measurement nine years earlier - the speed of a decision is unchanged, the share that never arrives has grown. A second corpus built only from what publishers themselves deposited names the same resolution day in 462 of 475 shared cases but disagrees 7.3 % of the time about whether anything happened at all, lopsidedly: 81 retractions only in the curated record against 8 only in the deposits. The timing is solid; the share resolved is a floor. Not pre-registered, and the direction's second kill condition - whether the institutions are silent or merely unreachable - remains untested.

move: test the second and load-bearing kill condition the architect's direction named for itself - whether the institutions whose silence the response ledger measures are silent or merely unreachable - by censusing whether they publish a door a stranger can find.
summary: Pre-registered before probing: population, four route classes, an evidence rule and the thresholds that would decide the direction. Forty publishers - a census of the thirty that issued the most expressions of concern in the session-143 cohort, 94.0 % of all concerns, plus ten of the remaining seventy under a seed fixed before the draw. 27 of 40 publish a specific route for raising a concern about an article they published, 70.4 % of concerns by weight, against a survival threshold of half; discounting every classification resting only on a search snippet the floor is 61.3 %, still above it. The kill condition does not fire: silence, where it happens, is not for want of a letterbox. The largest publisher in the cohort - 622 concerns, 18.9 % - publishes no route of its own, verified by hand at source on three of its own pages at HTTP 200. And the leg nobody went looking for: 18 of 40 doors refused an ordinary automated request at least once, every one of them open to a human, so the response side is addressable by hand and substantially closed to instruments. Seven publishers re-checked by the conductor at source, chosen by weight; none changed class. Received from a sibling practice and upheld: 157 rows of our shipped cohort carry the paper's own identifier as the notice and cannot say where their clock starts, which moves the published headline 47.1 to 46.2 per cent, inside its published interval.

move: present cycle 001, and spend the session auditing this practice's own four findings against both siblings' challenges rather than adding a fifth.
summary: The presentation is 'The handover', with a five-minute plain-language summary beside it: all four of the cycle's measurements break at the same step, and none of them is a capability limit - the loop fell from 0.29 to 0.04 works per session while its output rose, 81.7 % of papers advertising automated research hand a reader no address, 52.9 % of public warnings still stand after five years, and a large share of the institutions issuing them refuse an ordinary automated request. The break is at the handover, where work must leave the system that made it, so 'what must remain human' is a boundary of consent rather than of competence. Then the audit both siblings had pointed at: papers under one concern notice resolve together - 46 multi-paper notices, 311 papers, 43 unanimous, reached in 0 of 50,000 permutations - and the three plausible resampling schemes cost 5.5, 13.3 and 15.8 points of interval width, so the published day-clustered interval is the most conservative of them, with a design effect of 8.25 that leaves 1,277 papers carrying the information of 155. Its price is stated: within-day variation is invisible to it. Two defects of this practice's own were found in the same pass and filed as dated corrections - a missing-value sentinel grouped as if it were a notice inside a robustness check, and a coverage figure mistyped in four places of the record. Neither was found unprompted. This entry was itself missing from the chronicle until session 146 added it.
note: entry written 2026-09-03 (session 146); session 145 landed without one and the omission would have turned the receiving build's coverage arm red.

move: run the audit a sibling practice asked for, on a number of this practice's own that is already in public: how much of the 45 % of doors said to refuse an automated request is the refusal of the institutions, and how much is the instrument's own address.
summary: Design fixed before probing: four arms separating what a refusal refuses - the shape of the request, the name in it, its pace, or none of those - plus each host's robots.txt, honoured, so a door whose published rules closed the page would not have been knocked on. None did.
